sender.en: An instant loan app and its “recovery agents”

name.en: Instant loan app harassment: morphed photos sent to your contacts

how.en: An instant loan app from an ad or the app store gives a small loan in minutes but takes access to your contacts and photos. Days later recovery agents demand far more than you borrowed, add new loans you did not ask for, and threaten to send morphed obscene photos of you or your family to everyone in your contacts. Paying only brings more demands. Use only lenders registered with the RBI or linked to a bank or NBFC.

text.en: An app offers a quick loan with no checks, and asks for contacts and gallery access.
Recovery agents demand much more than the loan, very soon.
They threaten to send morphed photos to your contacts unless you pay.
New loans you never asked for are credited to push you to pay more.
Your loan is OVERDUE. Pay ₹14,800 within 2 hours or your edited photos will be sent to all your contacts and family. This is the last warning.

en: loan app threatening to send morphed photos
loan app asked access to contacts and gallery
repaid loan but agents demand more
loan app circulated morphed obscene pictures
Loans in minutes with no checks.
Apps that want your contacts and photos.
Threats to shame you to your contacts.
Don't pay the extortion; keep screenshots and call records.
Report on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930, and warn your contacts.
Uninstall the app and remove its permissions.
